title: Đề Tổng Hợp 100 Câu Mạng Máy Tính
description: Bộ câu hỏi ôn tập kì SP26 (Bộ 1 + Bộ 2). Gồm 50 câu lý thuyết và 50 câu thực hành, cấu hình.

questions.q: What is the correct order of the TCP three-way handshake?
questions.explain: Bắt tay ba bước TCP: Client gửi SYN → Server phản hồi SYN-ACK → Client xác nhận bằng ACK.

questions.q: What is the primary responsibility of the transport layer in the OSI model?
options: Managing logical communications between applications on different hosts
questions.explain: Lớp Transport chịu trách nhiệm quản lý giao tiếp logic giữa các ứng dụng trên các host khác nhau.

questions.q: What is the primary responsibility of the transport layer?
options: Formatting, or presenting, data into a compatible format.
Tracking individual conversations and segmenting data.
Translating domain names to IP addresses.
Securing the network from external threats.
questions.explain: Lớp Transport theo dõi các phiên giao tiếp và chia dữ liệu thành các segment.

questions.q: Which two fields are the same in a TCP and UDP header? (Choose two.)
questions.explain: Cả TCP và UDP đều có trường Source Port và Destination Port.

questions.q: When 2 or more bits in a data unit has been changed during the transmission, the error is called:
questions.explain: Burst error xảy ra khi hai hoặc nhiều bit liên tiếp bị hỏng trong quá trình truyền.

questions.q: Which of the following are features of the CSMA/CA method used in the university's 802.11 WLAN?
options: Devices include a duration field to reserve the medium
Devices transmit a frame only when the medium is idle
Devices wait a random period after detecting a collision
Devices operate in full-duplex mode to avoid collisions
questions.explain: CSMA/CA dùng trường Duration để đặt trước kênh và chỉ truyền khi kênh rảnh.

questions.q: Which statement describes the half-duplex mode of data transmission?
options: Data that is transmitted over the network can only flow in one direction.
Data that is transmitted over the network flows in both directions at the same time.
Data that is transmitted over the network flows in one direction to many different destinations simultaneously.
Data that is transmitted over the network flows in one direction at a time.
questions.explain: Half-duplex cho phép dữ liệu truyền theo cả hai hướng nhưng mỗi lần chỉ một hướng.

questions.q: UDP and TCP belong to which layer of the TCP/IP protocol?
questions.explain: UDP và TCP là giao thức thuộc lớp Transport.

questions.q: Which name is assigned to the transport layer PDU?
questions.explain: PDU ở tầng Transport là segment (đối với TCP).

questions.q: From the perspective of the client, what is the correct order of the protocol stack that is used to decode the received transmission?
questions.explain: Giải mã dữ liệu nhận được đi từ lớp dưới lên: Ethernet → IP → TCP → HTTP.

questions.q: Which statement accurately describes a TCP/IP encapsulation process when a PC is sending data to the network?
options: Data is sent from the internet layer to the network access layer.
Packets are sent from the network access layer to the transport layer.
Segments are sent from the transport layer to the internet layer.
Frames are sent from the network access layer to the internet layer.
questions.explain: Segments từ tầng Transport được gửi xuống tầng Internet để đóng gói thành packet.

questions.q: This is a function of the OSI session layer.
options: format data for the application layer
exchange of information to initiate dialog between peers
questions.explain: Lớp Session thiết lập, quản lý và kết thúc các phiên giao tiếp.

questions.q: Which of these addresses is the shortest abbreviation for the IP address: 3FFE:1044:0000:0000:00AB:0000:0000?
questions.explain: Rút gọn chuỗi 0 liên tiếp bằng :: và bỏ các số 0 ở đầu mỗi block.

questions.q: Which statement about IPv6 addresses is true?
options: IPv6 addresses are expressed in decimal format.
IPv6 addresses use 128 bits and are expressed in hexadecimal format.
IPv6 addresses use 32 bits and are expressed in binary format.
IPv6 addresses are composed of two parts: network and host.
questions.explain: Địa chỉ IPv6 dài 128 bit và biểu diễn dạng thập lục phân (hex).

questions.q: Which method allows a device to obtain an IPv6 address dynamically without the need for a DHCP server?
questions.explain: SLAAC cho phép thiết bị tự tạo địa chỉ IPv6 từ tiền tố mạng router quảng bá.

questions.q: Which IPv6 address type is used for communication within a single network segment and cannot be routed?
questions.explain: Địa chỉ Link-Local chỉ dùng trong một phân đoạn mạng duy nhất.

questions.q: Which two multicast addresses are commonly joined by IPv6 hosts and routers?
questions.explain: ff02::1 (tất cả các nút) và ff02::2 (tất cả các router) là các địa chỉ multicast phổ biến.

questions.q: Which two types of IPv6 messages are used in place of ARP for address resolution?
questions.explain: IPv6 dùng Neighbor Solicitation và Neighbor Advertisement thay cho ARP.

questions.q: What protocol does IPv6 use for address resolution, replacing the function of ARP in IPv4?
questions.explain: ICMPv6 Neighbor Discovery đảm nhận chức năng giải quyết địa chỉ.

questions.q: How can you view the ARP table on a Windows PC?
questions.explain: Lệnh 'arp -a' hiển thị bảng ARP trên Windows.

questions.q: Which statement describes the treatment of ARP requests on the local link?
options: They must be forwarded by all routers on the local network.
They are received and processed by every device on the local network.
They are dropped by all switches on the local network.
They are received and processed only by the target device.
questions.explain: ARP request là broadcast, mọi thiết bị trong mạng cục bộ đều nhận và xử lý.

questions.q: What type of network would the employee access to get confidential pricing information from internal servers at the Head Office?
questions.explain: Intranet là mạng nội bộ dùng để chia sẻ tài nguyên nội bộ.

questions.q: Which device performs the function of determining the path that messages should take through internetworks?
questions.explain: Router xác định đường đi tối ưu cho các gói tin.

questions.q: Which of the four basic characteristics of a reliable network architecture refers to the ability to quickly and easily expand to support new users and applications?
questions.explain: Scalability (khả năng mở rộng) giúp mạng dễ dàng đáp ứng thêm người dùng.

questions.q: What are two actions performed by a Cisco switch? (Choose two.)
options: building a routing table that is based on the first IP address in the frame header
using the source MAC addresses of frames to build and maintain a MAC address table
forwarding frames with unknown destination IP addresses to the default gateway
utilizing the MAC address table to forward frames via the destination MAC address
examining the destination MAC address to add new entries to the MAC address table
questions.explain: Switch dùng MAC nguồn để xây dựng bảng MAC và dùng MAC đích để chuyển tiếp frame.

questions.q: Which three statements are correct about the final result of connecting two modern switches using a straight-through cable? (Choose three.)
options: The link between the switches will work at the fastest speed that is supported by both switches.
The link between switches will work as full-duplex.
If both switches support different speeds, they will each work at their own fastest speed.
The auto-MDIX feature will configure the interfaces eliminating the need for a crossover cable.
The connection will not be possible unless the administrator changes the cable to a crossover cable.
The duplex capability has to be manually configured because it cannot be negotiated.
questions.explain: Auto-MDIX tự động nhận diện cáp, link hoạt động ở tốc độ cao nhất và full-duplex.

questions.q: What is wrong with the displayed termination? (Photograph showing an RJ-45 connector incorrectly terminated)
options: The woven copper braid should not have been removed.
The wrong type of connector is being used.
The untwisted length of each wire is too long.
The wires are too thick for the connector that is used.
questions.explain: Phần dây bị bóc vỏ và không xoắn quá dài (quá 1.27cm) gây nhiễu tín hiệu.

questions.q: Which sublayer handles Ethernet addressing?
questions.explain: Sublayer MAC chịu trách nhiệm về địa chỉ MAC (Ethernet addressing).

questions.q: What source IP address does a router use by default when the traceroute command is issued?
options: the highest configured IP address on the router
the IP address of the outbound interface
the lowest configured IP address on the router
questions.explain: Router mặc định dùng IP của cổng xuất (outbound interface) làm nguồn.

questions.q: Which ICMP message is used by the traceroute utility during the process of finding the path between two end hosts?
questions.explain: Traceroute dùng ICMP Time Exceeded để xác định các hop trên đường đi.

questions.q: What is a function of the tracert command that differs from the ping command when they are used on a workstation?
options: The tracert command reaches the destination faster.
The tracert command shows the information of routers in the path.
The tracert command sends one ICMP message to each hop in the path.
The tracert command is used to test the connectivity between two devices.
questions.explain: Tracert hiển thị thông tin các router (hop) mà gói tin đi qua.

questions.q: Which three factors could influence the differences in throughput? (Choose three.)
options: the amount of traffic that is currently crossing the network
the sophistication of the encapsulation method applied to the data
the type of traffic that is crossing the network
the latency that is created by the number of network devices that the data is crossing
the bandwidth of the WAN connection to the Internet
the reliability of the gigabit Ethernet infrastructure of the backbone
questions.explain: Throughput bị ảnh hưởng bởi lượng traffic, loại traffic và độ trễ (latency).

questions.q: Which type of fiber-optic cabling is characterized by a very small core and is used for long-distance applications?
questions.explain: Single-Mode Fiber có lõi nhỏ, dùng cho khoảng cách xa.

questions.q: What term refers to the amount of data that can be transmitted over a medium in a given time?
questions.explain: Bandwidth là lượng dữ liệu tối đa có thể truyền qua môi trường trong một khoảng thời gian.

questions.q: What are two functions of NVRAM? (Choose two.)
options: to retain contents when power is removed
to store the startup configuration file
to contain the running configuration file
questions.explain: NVRAM giữ nội dung khi mất điện và lưu file cấu hình khởi động.

questions.q: Which two functions are primary functions of a router? (Choose two.)
questions.explain: Router có 2 chức năng chính: chuyển tiếp gói tin và chọn đường đi.

questions.q: What is a description of the default gateway address?
options: It is the IP address of the Router1 interface that connects the company to the Internet.
It is the IP address of the Router1 interface that connects the PC1 LAN to Router1.
It is the IP address of Switch1 that connects PC1 to other devices on the same LAN.
It is the IP address of the ISP network device located in the cloud.
questions.explain: Default gateway là địa chỉ IP của cổng router kết nối với mạng LAN của PC.

questions.q: A router's G0/0/0 interface is down even though configuration is correct. What could explain this?
options: The "no shutdown" command was not applied
There is no device connected to the interface
The IP address is not unique
questions.explain: Cổng trên router Cisco mặc định bị tắt (administratively down), cần gõ 'no shutdown'.

questions.q: How many usable IP addresses are available on the 192.168.1.0/27 network?
questions.explain: /27 có 32 địa chỉ, trừ 2 địa chỉ mạng và broadcast còn 30 host.

questions.q: What type of address is 198.133.219.162?
questions.explain: Đây là địa chỉ IP công cộng (Public IP).

questions.q: How many host addresses are available on the network 172.16.128.0 with a subnet mask of 255.255.252.0?
questions.explain: Subnet mask /22, có 10 bit host (2^10 = 1024), trừ 2 còn 1022 host.

questions.q: Which of the following is a private IP address according to RFC 1918? (Select TWO answers)
questions.explain: 10.0.0.0/8 và 172.16.0.0/12 là các dải IP private.

questions.q: Which command is used to secure privileged EXEC mode on a switch?
questions.explain: Lệnh 'enable secret' mã hóa mật khẩu để bảo vệ chế độ đặc quyền.

questions.q: Which access method would be the most appropriate in-band access to the IOS over a network connection?
questions.explain: Telnet/SSH là truy cập in-band qua mạng IP.

questions.q: Which Cisco IOS command mode allows access to all commands and features and is identified by a prompt ending in the # symbol?
questions.explain: Privileged EXEC Mode (dấu #) cho phép truy cập mọi lệnh.

questions.q: Which access method would be most appropriate if you were in the equipment room with a new switch that needs to be configured?
questions.explain: Khi cấu hình switch mới chưa có mạng, dùng cáp Console.

questions.q: Which OSI layer sends segments to be encapsulated in an IPv4 or IPv6 packet?
questions.explain: Transport layer tạo segment và gửi xuống Network layer.

questions.q: Match the packets with their destination IP address to the exiting interfaces on the router.
questions.explain: Dựa vào bảng định tuyến để chọn cổng ra phù hợp.

questions.q: What are the two most commonly referenced fields in an IPv4 packet header that indicate where the packet is coming from and where it is going? (Choose two.)
questions.explain: Source IP và Destination IP là hai trường quan trọng nhất.

questions.q: Which statement describes a feature of the IP protocol?
options: IP encapsulation is modified based on network media.
IP relies on Layer 2 protocols for transmission error control.
MAC addresses are used during the IP packet encapsulation.
IP relies on upper layer services to handle situations of missing or out-of-order packets.
questions.explain: IP là giao thức unreliable, dựa vào lớp trên (như TCP) để xử lý mất gói/sai thứ tự.

questions.q: Which three fields are used in a UDP segment header? (Choose three.)
questions.explain: UDP header gồm Source Port, Destination Port, Length, Checksum.

questions.q: A client packet is received by a server. The packet has a destination port number of 22. What service is the client requesting?
questions.explain: Cổng 22 là cổng mặc định của SSH.

questions.q: What are three responsibilities of the transport layer? (Choose three.)
options: meeting the reliability requirements of applications, if any
multiplexing multiple communication streams from many users or applications on the same network
identifying the applications and services on the client and server that should handle transmitted data
directing packets towards the destination network
formatting data into a compatible form for receipt by the destination devices
conducting error detection of the contents in frames
questions.explain: Transport layer đảm bảo độ tin cậy, đa hợp luồng, và xác định ứng dụng.

questions.q: What field is used by the destination host to reassemble segments into the original order?
questions.explain: Sequence number giúp sắp xếp lại các segment đúng thứ tự.

questions.q: What are the three basic parts of a data link frame?
questions.explain: Frame gồm Header, Data và Trailer.

questions.q: Which two statements describe the services provided by the data link layer? (Choose two.)
options: It defines the end-to-end delivery addressing scheme.
It maintains the path between the source and destination devices during the data transmission.
It manages the access of frames to the network media.
It provides reliable delivery through link establishment and flow control.
It ensures that application data will be transmitted according to the prioritization.
It packages various Layer 3 PDUs into a frame format that is compatible with the network interface.
questions.explain: Data link layer quản lý truy cập phương tiện và đóng gói PDU L3 thành frame.

questions.q: Which topology displays networking device layer IP addresses?
questions.explain: Logical topology hiển thị địa chỉ IP và cấu trúc logic.

questions.q: Which two benefits result from using a layered model in networking? (Select two answers)
questions.explain: Mô hình phân lớp giúp dễ gỡ lỗi và tăng khả năng tương tác.

questions.q: What does the OSI model help with in networking?
questions.explain: OSI giúp chuẩn hóa và hỗ trợ xử lý sự cố.

questions.q: In network communication, what is the process of breaking up messages into smaller, more manageable units called?
questions.explain: Quá trình chia nhỏ dữ liệu là Segmenting.

questions.q: Which two models are used to describe network protocols and operations? (Select two answers)
questions.explain: TCP/IP và OSI là 2 mô hình mạng phổ biến.

questions.q: Which email protocol is used to retrieve mail from a server and typically deletes the messages on the server after download?
questions.explain: POP thường xóa thư trên server sau khi tải về.

questions.q: A technician configures a router interface with "ipv6 address fe80::1 link-local". What is the purpose of this address?
options: It enables communication on the local link
It routes packets to other networks
It acts as a default gateway for global IPv6 traffic
questions.explain: Địa chỉ fe80:: là link-local, dùng để giao tiếp trong cùng link.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the IPv6 unique local address (ULA)?
options: To allow devices to communicate with the global internet
To provide a globally unique address
To allow communication within a local site without global routing
To enable multicast communication within a network
questions.explain: ULA dùng cho giao tiếp nội bộ, không định tuyến ra toàn cầu.

questions.q: What is used in the EUI-64 process to create an IPv6 interface ID on an IPv6 enabled interface?
options: the MAC address of the IPv6 enabled interface
an IPv6 address that is provided by a DHCPv6 server
an IPv4 address that is configured on the interface
questions.explain: EUI-64 tạo interface ID từ địa chỉ MAC 48-bit.

questions.q: What is the prefix length of an IPv6 address that is typically used for a single subnet?
questions.explain: /64 là tiền tố tiêu chuẩn cho một subnet IPv6.

questions.q: Which part of a GUA is assigned by the ISP?
options: Global routing prefix and subnet ID
questions.explain: ISP cấp Global routing prefix cho tổ chức.

questions.q: A host sends an IPv6 Neighbor Solicitation (NS) to determine a MAC address. What type of address is used for this request?
questions.explain: NS sử dụng địa chỉ solicited-node multicast.

questions.q: Which two techniques are used to resolve MAC addresses from IP addresses on IPv4 and IPv6 networks? (Choose two)
questions.explain: IPv4 dùng ARP, IPv6 dùng ND.

questions.q: What statement describes the function of the Address Resolution Protocol?
options: ARP is used to discover the IP address of any host on a different network.
ARP is used to discover the IP address of any host on the local network.
ARP is used to discover the MAC address of any host on a different network.
ARP is used to discover the MAC address of any host on the local network.
questions.explain: ARP tìm địa chỉ MAC từ IP trong cùng mạng cục bộ.

questions.q: What is the primary purpose of the Address Resolution Protocol (ARP)?
options: To resolve IPv6 addresses to MAC addresses.
To resolve domain names to IP addresses.
To resolve IPv4 addresses to MAC addresses.
To assign IP addresses to hosts dynamically.
questions.explain: ARP phân giải địa chỉ IPv4 thành địa chỉ MAC.

questions.q: Which network infrastructure might an organization use to provide secure and safe access to individuals who work for a different organization but require access to the organization's data?
questions.explain: Extranet cho phép người ngoài truy cập an toàn vào dữ liệu.

questions.q: A networking technician is working on the wireless network at a medical clinic. The technician accidentally sets up the wireless network so that patients can see the medical records data of other patients. Which of the network characteristics has been violated in this situation?
questions.explain: Việc lộ dữ liệu bệnh nhân vi phạm tính bảo mật (security).

questions.q: Which of the following is a characteristic of a peer-to-peer (P2P) network?
options: It is easy to set up.
questions.explain: Mạng P2P rất dễ thiết lập.

questions.q: Which types of UTP cables can be used to connect the devices? (PC to console, Switch to Router, Router to Router)
questions.explain: PC-console dùng rollover, Switch-Router dùng straight-through, Router-Router dùng crossover.

questions.q: What action does a switch take when it receives a frame with a destination MAC address that is not in its MAC address table?
options: It sends the frame back to the source device.
It forwards the frame out all ports except the incoming port.
It sends an ARP request to find the destination device.
questions.explain: Switch sẽ flood frame ra tất cả các cổng trừ cổng nhận.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the Organizationally Unique Identifier (OUI) in an Ethernet MAC address?
options: To identify the specific device on the network.
To identify the vendor of the Ethernet device.
To specify the network layer protocol being used.
To detect errors within the Ethernet frame.
questions.explain: OUI (3 byte đầu) xác định nhà sản xuất thiết bị.

questions.q: What are two examples of the cut-through switching method? (Choose two.)
questions.explain: Cut-through gồm fast-forward và fragment-free.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of ICMP?
options: To test and report on network connectivity and issues.
To secure network devices from attacks.
questions.explain: ICMP dùng để kiểm tra và báo cáo lỗi kết nối mạng.

questions.q: Which command can be used to test network connectivity and measure the time it takes for a packet to reach a destination?
questions.explain: Lệnh ping đo thời gian khứ hồi (RTT).

questions.q: Which command is commonly used to test the internal configuration of IPv4 or IPv6 on the local host?
questions.explain: Ping loopback (127.0.0.1 hoặc ::1) kiểm tra cấu hình TCP/IP nội bộ.

questions.q: What is the purpose of encoding?
options: To ensure the accuracy and reliability of data by checking for transmission errors
To convert data into a transmittable format
questions.explain: Encoding chuyển đổi dữ liệu thành định dạng có thể truyền đi.

questions.q: Which of the following fiber-optic cable types can travel approximately 100 km?
questions.explain: Single-mode truyền xa khoảng 100km.

questions.q: Match the situation with the appropriate use of network media.
questions.explain: Horizontal/Desktop dùng Copper (A), Backbone/Long-haul dùng Fiber (B), Guest/Waiting dùng Wireless (C).

questions.q: Which command can be used on a Cisco router to display all interfaces, the IPv4 address assigned, and the current status?
questions.explain: Lệnh 'show ip interface brief' hiển thị tóm tắt trạng thái và IP các cổng.

questions.q: How does a router process a packet when no matching route exists in the routing table?
options: It forwards the packet to the default route (if configured) or drops it
It sends the packet to all interfaces
It assigns a random route to the packet
It broadcasts the packet across the network
questions.explain: Router dùng default route hoặc hủy gói tin nếu không tìm thấy đường đi.

questions.q: Match the commands to the correct actions.
questions.explain: Bảo mật console (A->3), hiển thị thông báo (B->5), đặt tên router (C->1).

questions.q: A new network administrator has been asked to enter a banner message on a Cisco device. What is the fastest way a network administrator could test whether the banner is properly configured?
options: Enter CTRL-Z at the privileged mode prompt.
Exit privileged EXEC mode and press Enter.
questions.explain: Thoát khỏi EXEC đặc quyền và nhấn Enter sẽ hiển thị banner ngay.

questions.q: What is the ANDing process used for?
options: To securely encrypt communication between multiple network endpoints
questions.explain: Phép AND giữa IP và Subnet Mask dùng để tìm địa chỉ mạng.

questions.q: A technician needs to configure a point-to-point WAN link and a subnet for a department with 50 hosts. Which subnet mask combinations are appropriate and efficient for these two use cases?
questions.explain: /30 (2 host) cho WAN, /26 (62 host) cho phòng ban 50 host.

questions.q: What is the logical process used by a device to determine the network address of an IPv4 address?
questions.explain: Dùng phép ANDing logic.

questions.q: What is the purpose of subnetting a network?
options: To increase the number of available host addresses in a network.
To create a single, large broadcast domain.
To reduce the size of the network into smaller broadcast domains.
To simplify the IP addressing scheme.
questions.explain: Subnetting chia mạng lớn thành các broadcast domain nhỏ hơn.

questions.q: Which IOS mode allows access to all commands and features?
questions.explain: Privileged EXEC mode cho phép truy cập mọi lệnh.

questions.q: Which command is used to save the active configuration file (running-config) to the file that is used upon startup or reboot (startup-config)?
questions.explain: Lệnh copy running-config startup-config lưu cấu hình đang chạy vào bộ nhớ khởi động.

questions.q: Which command is used to secure access to privileged EXEC mode on a switch?
questions.explain: enable secret đặt mật khẩu mã hóa mạnh.

questions.q: An administrator is trying to configure the switch but receives the error message "Invalid input detected". What is the problem?
options: The entire command, configure terminal, must be used.
The administrator is already in global configuration mode.
The administrator must first enter privileged EXEC mode before issuing the command.
The administrator must connect via the console port to access global configuration mode.
questions.explain: Lệnh 'config t' chỉ dùng được khi đang ở Privileged EXEC mode (dấu #).

questions.q: What is a key difference between IPv4 and IPv6 packet headers?
options: IPv6 headers are simpler and have fewer fields than IPv4 headers
IPv6 headers are more complex than IPv4 headers
IPv4 headers are always smaller than IPv6 headers
IPv6 requires NAT, while IPv4 does not
questions.explain: Header IPv6 đơn giản hơn và ít trường hơn IPv4.

questions.q: What is the purpose of a default gateway?
options: To connect to the same LAN
To forward packets to remote networks
questions.explain: Default gateway chuyển tiếp gói tin ra các mạng từ xa.

questions.q: Which is true of the IPv6 packet header?
options: The Hop Limit field replaces the IPv4 Time to Live field.
The Source and Destination IPv6 addresses change while travelling from source to destination.
The Time to Live field replaces the DiffServ field.
The Version field identifies the next header.
questions.explain: Hop Limit trong IPv6 thay thế TTL trong IPv4.

questions.q: In an IPv4 packet header, what is the purpose of the Time-to-Live (TTL) field?
options: To identify the upper-level protocol like TCP or UDP.
To detect corruption in the IPv4 header.
To limit the lifetime of a packet, acting as a hop count.
To reassemble fragmented packets at the destination.
questions.explain: TTL giới hạn số hop của gói tin, tránh vòng lặp vô hạn.
